source_selection: C-drive final release supersedes E-drive provisional B handoff; original inputs unchanged

projection.studio: first declared studio name, exact casefolded match
projection.semantic_text: five dimensions only; no title, synopsis, ratings or relations

sampling: 300 uniform stratified titles (75 per membership quartile), plus 300 random titles from the top-2000 membership band; all exclude v1 targets
ground_truth: MAL recommendation votes, independent of co-high-rating training pairs; human labels initially absent
